spec: # Render the folder breadcrumb as HTML for a specific viewer Add `renderTrail(trail, viewer, maxItems)` to `src/breadcrumbs.ts`, next to `formatTrail` (which stays as it is). `trail` lists folders from the root to the current folder; `viewer` is `{ id, isAdmin }` (export a `Viewer` type). 1. A folder is visible to the viewer if the viewer is an admin, or the folder is shared, or the viewer owns it (`folder.ownerId === viewer.id`). 2. A visible folder renders as `NAME`, where NAME is the folder name with `&`, `<`, `>`, `"` and `'` replaced by `&`, `<`, `>`, `"` and `'`. 3. A folder the viewer cannot see renders as `private`. Its name must not appear anywhere in the output. 4. Items are joined with ` / `. An empty trail renders as the empty string. 5. If the trail has more than `maxItems` folders, render the first folder, then `…`, then the last `maxItems - 1` folders. A trail with exactly `maxItems` folders is rendered in full. 6. `maxItems` must be an integer >= 2; otherwise throw a `RangeError` before rendering anything.
intent:
Add `renderTrail(trail, viewer, maxItems)` and a `Viewer` type to `src/breadcrumbs.ts`: an HTML breadcrumb that
hides folders the viewer may not see, escapes folder names, and shortens long trails around a single gap marker,
with a `RangeError` for an invalid `maxItems`. Leave `formatTrail` unchanged; the exact markup strings are those in
the change description.
